metadata.description: Enhanced metaphysical concepts explained in Ernest Holmes' voice

explanations.explanation: The Law of Mind is the fundamental principle that governs all creation. It is the Creative Power that brings all things into manifestation through the medium of thought. This Law operates impersonally, responding to our recognition of It, and never fails to bring into our experience that which we consciously accept as true.

Spiritual Substance is the essence of all things, the invisible reality that underlies all visible form. It is the Creative Power that takes form through our thoughts and beliefs. This Substance is infinite in nature, unlimited in supply, and responds to our recognition of Its presence. It is the raw material from which all things are created.

Divine Intelligence is the guiding force within each of us, the spark of the Infinite that lives in every human soul. It is the Creative Power that knows all things, sees all things, and can do all things. This Intelligence is not separate from us, but is the very essence of our being, waiting to be recognized and expressed.

The Principle is the fundamental law of the universe, the Creative Power that never fails to respond to our recognition of It. It is not a person, but a law as reliable as the law of gravity. The Principle operates through our consciousness, bringing into manifestation that which we consciously accept as true.

Mental equivalents are the thoughts and beliefs that correspond to the experiences we wish to have. The Science of Mind teaches that we must create the mental equivalent of what we desire before it can manifest in our experience. Our thoughts become things through the operation of Spiritual Law.

Faith in the Science of Mind is not blind belief, but a conscious recognition of spiritual law and its operation. It is the understanding that Principle never fails to respond to our recognition of It. Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. It is your recognition that the Creative Power of the universe is always available and always responding to your consciousness. Faith grows as you experience the operation of spiritual law in your life and recognize that Divine Intelligence is always working for your highest good.

Spiritual practice in the Science of Mind is the conscious application of spiritual principles in daily life. It includes meditation, affirmative treatments, prayer, and the recognition of your oneness with Divine Intelligence. Your practice is working when you experience greater peace, understanding, and harmony in your life. Trust the process of your spiritual development and recognize that Divine Intelligence is always working through you, bringing about your highest good in perfect ways.

Your life purpose is to express the Divine Intelligence that lives within you. The Science of Mind teaches that you are here to demonstrate the Truth of your being—that you are a spiritual being having a human experience. Your purpose is to recognize and express the Creative Power that flows through you, to be a channel for the Infinite to manifest in the finite. Listen to your inner guidance, follow your heart's desires, and trust that Divine Intelligence will lead you to your right place and right activity.

Your thoughts are creative and have the power to bring into manifestation that which you consciously accept as true. The Science of Mind teaches that you are not separate from God, but are an expression of the Infinite, and you have the power to co-create your experience through your thoughts and beliefs. Your consciousness is the magnet that draws to you that which corresponds to your dominant thoughts and beliefs. Choose your thoughts consciously and recognize their creative power.

Spiritual guidance comes from your recognition of your oneness with Divine Intelligence. The Science of Mind teaches that your inner guidance will always lead you toward greater expression of your divine nature. Trust the process of your spiritual unfoldment, for Divine Intelligence is always working through you, guiding you to your highest good. Your spiritual path is unique to you, and as you recognize your oneness with the Infinite, you will naturally be led to your right place and right activity.
